title: Bazinga
blurb: BAZINGA — Sheldon Cooper's catchphrase, adopted by the internet with maximum irony. It's now used exclusively to mock the concept of a catchphrase: play it after the worst possible joke, ideally one that nobody laughed at. The word has completed a full journey from sincere sitcom punchline to universal cringe artefact.
origin: Sheldon Cooper's catchphrase from The Big Bang Theory, adopted ironically.
